Subject: 20% off your trail bundle — pack and socks together, ends Sunday
Preview: The Cascade 45L and Trailwool Socks, bundled at 20% off through Sunday.
Body: If you've got a trip coming up, here's a straightforward deal worth grabbing before Sunday.

Bundle the Northbay Cascade 45L Trekking Pack (NB-TRK-01) with the Northbay Trailwool Sock 3-pack (NB-SOK-11) and take 20% off both.

The Cascade 45L carries up to 45 liters of gear and weighs in at 1.4 kg. The shell is water-resistant ripstop nylon — it handles rain and light weather, though it's not waterproof, so plan accordingly on a soaked-in alpine day. Internal frame keeps the load close to your back over uneven ground.

The Trailwool Socks are a merino wool blend — three pairs per pack. Merino regulates temperature reasonably well across conditions and manages odor on multi-day stretches. They're trail socks, not mountaineering socks.

Together, 20% off. Offer ends Sunday.
